newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 31.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* News Corp's Fox Television Stations are expected as early as Friday to unveil a deal giving Petry Television responsibility for national ad sales at all 22 of the Fox and former New World TV stations. The move could boost Petry Television's efforts to take the company public. Some say Petry will likely form a separate division to handle the ad sales of Fox's stations, which will total about $550 million a year and an estimated 55 percent of all Petry billing.

* As Time Warner's WB Network proceeds with its plans for cable distribution in markets ranked 100 and beyond, Chris-Craft Industries' United Paramount Network is looking to increase its distribution by snagging those WB affiliates left by the wayside.
* Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS is scrapping a 60 Minutes segment planned for this Sunday on an interview with actor Bill Cosby.

* Tom Sherak, who has been widely recognized as the driving force behind the remarkable success of Independence Day, has been promoted to chairman of 20th Domestic Film Group, a newly formed division of Fox Filmed Entertainment.
